description: Log time already worked as one entry and return its id, duration and amount. Give start plus end or minutes. rate is hourly in MAJOR units and is frozen on the entry, so a later rate change never moves it.

billable.description: Default true; set false for non-billable work

currency.description: Currency of the rate: EUR, USD, GBP, PLN, or words like 'euros'. Defaults to the project currency, else USD.

project.description: Project or client name. A partial name that matches exactly one existing project is used as that project.

rate.description: Hourly rate for this entry; a number (90) or the words the user said ('90 euros an hour')

name: entry_add
title: Add time entry
